name: Jonathan R. Booker
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Denver, Colorado

about: Jonathan R. Booker is a Partner with the law firm of Hernandez & Associates, P.C., in Denver, Colorado, and he serves as director of criminal law. Focusing his practice solely on criminal defense, Mr. Booker provides unmatched counsel and support to clients across Colorado who stand accused of or are under investigation for felony or misdemeanor offenses including the following:
· Immigration law issues caused by criminal charges

Known for his fierce and impassioned advocacy, Mr. Booker is a tenacious litigator, and he has achieved a long record of obtaining successful outcomes for his clients while protecting their rights and liberties at all turns. From his efforts, he has secured numerous acquittals, dismissals and reductions of charges for the accused, and he has gained a reputation for his outstanding professionalism and integrity along with his unwavering resolve for helping his clients achieve the favorable outcomes they seek efficiently and cost-effectively.

Honored for his success, Mr. Booker has earned consistent recognition from his peers. In 2019, he graduated from the prestigious Colorado Bar Association Leadership Training Program; in 2021, he was elected and served as President of the Colorado Hispanic Bar Association; and in 2023, he was elected to the Board of Directors for the Colorado Criminal Defense Bar. In addition, he has received many testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients, and he finds great reward in being able to help so many individuals defend against criminal accusations in their times of dire need.
